sourceLimits: Internal original-project V2 portrait is selected identity authority, not external franchise proof or certification of absolute 1:1.
Source anatomy, hands, apron and hammer are visible; hidden surfaces and microdetails remain unknown.
Doros is the standing human blacksmith; bronze kneeling automaton is a repaired companion, not Doros or another human. It is contextual and is omitted from most solo poses and all atlas poses.
No chronological age is established; all variants remain fully clothed, family-safe and nonromantic.
Old atlas is historical evidence only and visibly omits source hammer, apron and tied hair; it is preserved byte-identical.
